description: This file defines the RGraph library's rose chart component, including its constructor, background drawing, and data rendering methods. It sets up properties, handles configuration, and manages drawing logic for rose charts within a canvas element.

classes.name: RGraph.Rose
classes.description: Constructor for creating a rose chart object, managing properties, drawing background, and rendering data segments.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Setter method for configuration properties, supports object style and individual property setting.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Getter method for retrieving configuration property values.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main method to draw the entire rose chart, including background, segments, labels, and effects.

methods.name: drawBackground
methods.description: Draws the background grid, axes, and spokes of the rose chart.

methods.name: drawRose
methods.description: Draws the data segments of the rose chart, handling different data formats and chart variants.

methods.name: roundRobin
methods.description: Animates the rose chart with a round robin effect, cycling through frames with configurable options.

methods.name: implode
methods.description: Gradually decreases the size of the rose chart's explode property, creating an implosion effect.

methods.name: grow
methods.description: Gradually increases the size of the rose chart, creating a grow effect.
